sentences.translation: When the destructive sunset finally disappeared, leaving only a layer of blood red smeared by the hellfire of the earth in the clouds, several lines of large characters appeared:
sentences.explanation: This sentence describes a dramatic scene where a layer of blood red color appears in the clouds after the destructive sunset disappears, setting the stage for the appearance of large characters.

content.raw_text: 183号文明在“三日凌空”中毁灭了，该文明进化至中世纪层次。

sentences.text: 183号文明在“三日凌空”中毁灭了，该文明进化至中世纪层次。
sentences.translation: Civilization 183 was destroyed in the 'Three Days of Lingkong', and this civilization had evolved to the level of the Middle Ages.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the destruction of a civilization during an event called 'Three Days of Lingkong', and mentions that this civilization had reached the level of the Middle Ages.

content.raw_text: 漫长的时间后，生命和文明将重新启动，再次开始在三体世界中命运莫测的进化。

sentences.text: 漫长的时间后，生命和文明将重新启动，再次开始在三体世界中命运莫测的进化。
sentences.translation: After a long time, life and civilization will restart, once again embarking on an unpredictable evolution in the Three-Body world.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes a process of restarting life and civilization in the Three-Body world after a long time, emphasizing the unpredictable nature of their evolution.

content.raw_text: 但在这次文明中，哥白尼成功地揭示了宇宙的基本结构，三体文明将产生第一次飞跃，游戏进入第二级。

sentences.text: 但在这次文明中，哥白尼成功地揭示了宇宙的基本结构，三体文明将产生第一次飞跃，游戏进入第二级。
sentences.translation: But in this civilization, Copernicus successfully revealed the basic structure of the universe, the Trisolaran civilization will make its first leap, and the game will enter the second level.
sentences.explanation: The sentence describes the significant achievements of Copernicus in revealing the structure of the universe within the context of the Trisolaran civilization making advancements.

content.raw_text: 欢迎您登录第二级《三体》。

sentences.text: 欢迎您登录第二级《三体》。
sentences.translation: Welcome to log in to the second level of 'The Three-Body Problem'.
sentences.explanation: The use of '您' is the polite form of 'you' in Chinese. The title '三体' is enclosed in double angle brackets to indicate it is a book title.
